title: Repository metadata
description: Governs the '.repo-metadata.jsonc' file at the root of a given repository.

$schema.description: Identifying HTTPS URL of the governing JSONschema. Must reference either the floating major-version tag (e.g. v2) or an exact, immutable release tag under it (e.g. v2.0.0).

name.description: Short repository identifier, preferably lowercase. ASCII alphanumerics, '.', '-', and '_' only; must not be '.' or '..', nor end in '.git' or '.wiki' (case-insensitive).

owner.description: Repository owner (organization or user). ASCII alphanumerics and single hyphens, not leading or trailing; Enterprise Managed Users may carry a trailing '_<shortcode>' of 3-8 alphanumerics.

slug.description: The repository slug. Format: <username>/<repository>. Each half follows the same rules as 'owner' and 'name' respectively.

examples: Proton Mail sieve filters for automatic label and decay of received email
Parses a quotes.json file, formats context, prints accordingly. Utilised as a shell post-initalisation splash.
Source file to initialise Zsh for repository. Repository root must be the real parent directory of this file.

license.description: Repository license information, preferably in accordance with SPDX specification.

filepath.description: Filepath of license file to relative to repo-metadata object file

spdx_id.description: License identifier according to https://spdx.org/licenses/, or a custom 'LicenseRef-' identifier. ASCII alphanumerics separated by single '.' or '-', with an optional trailing '+'.

full_name.description: Full name of the repository governing license
examples: GNU General Public License v3.0 only

url.description: License external file URL, preferably of https://spdx.org/licenses/{}

homepage.description: URL of associated homepage, documentation, or whatever most relevant.

category.description: The category per which this repository belongs. Only alphanumerics and hyphens, all lowercase, must start with an alphanumeric, and no consecutive hyphens.

topics.description: Descriptive keywords or tags typically employed for search indexing.

items.description: Only alphanumerics and hyphens, all lowercase, must start with an alphanumeric, and no consecutive hyphens.

language.description: Primary language of the repository functional content.

immutable_releases.description: Whether this repository has immutable releases functionality enabled.

archived.description: Whether this repository is currently archived.

is_template.description: Whether this repository is available as a template

has_issues.description: Whether this repository permits issue creation

has_projects.description: Whether this repository has Projects functionality enabled

has_wiki.description: Whether this repository has Wiki functionality enabled

has_pull_requests.description: Whether this repository permits pull requests

allow_forking.description: Whether this repository allows private forks.

allow_squash_merge.description: Whether this repository permits squash-merging pull requests

allow_merge_commit.description: Whether this repository permits merging pull requests via merge commit

allow_rebase_merge.description: Whether this repository permits rebase-merging pull requests

allow_auto_merge.description: Whether this repository permits auto-merge pull requests

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Whether this repository deletes head branches pull request post-merge

allow_update_branch.description: Whether this repository mandates an out-of-date pull request head branch to update before merge

squash_merge_commit_title.description: Default squash merge commit title. Must be defined if squash_merge_commit_message is.

squash_merge_commit_message.description: Default squash merge commit message. If defined, squash_merge_commit_title must also be.

merge_commit_title.description: Default merge commit title. Must be defined if merge_commit_message is.

merge_commit_message.description: Default merge commit message. If defined, merge_commit_title must also be.

web_commit_signoff_required.description: Whether this repository mandates web commits from contributors be authenticated.
